steps.text: Right click the shovel to dig. Click on the ground (where items appear) to dig a hole. Select the seeds then click on the hold to plant
Wagons provide extra inventory space for your journey. They are easier to pull on roads and sidewalks. Wagons can also be equipped with electric motors and batteries for easier movement.
Craft a campfire to cook food and boil dirty water.
Use a knife on clothing to create rags. Rags can be used in crafting and as fuel for fires.
Use an empty water bottle on a water puddle to collect dirty water
You should put some clothes on before going outside. When you run out of ACTION POINTS, end your turn.
